english: Washing hands with soap and water helps remove germs from the hands and reduce the spread of infections.
urdu: صابن اور پانی سے ہاتھ دھونے سے ہاتھوں پر موجود جراثیم دور کرنے اور انفیکشن کے پھیلاؤ کو کم کرنے میں مدد ملتی ہے۔
roman_urdu: Sabun aur pani se haath dhone se haathon par mojood jaraseem door karne aur infection ke phailao ko kam karne mein madad milti hai.
source_title: CDC: Hand Hygiene Frequently Asked Questions
source_note: CDC states that handwashing is one of the best ways to remove germs and prevent their spread; soap and water trap and remove germs.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Antibiotics cure the common cold.
urdu: اینٹی بایوٹکس عام نزلہ زکام کا علاج کرتی ہیں۔
roman_urdu: Antibiotics aam nazla zukam ka ilaaj karti hain.
source_note: FDA states antibiotics are not effective against viral infections such as the common cold.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: HPV vaccination can prevent cervical cancer.
urdu: ایچ پی وی ویکسینیشن سروائیکل کینسر سے بچاؤ میں مدد دے سکتی ہے۔
roman_urdu: HPV vaccination cervical cancer se bachao mein madad de sakti hai.
source_note: WHO states prophylactic HPV vaccination can prevent HPV-related cancers, including cervical cancer.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: COVID-19 mRNA vaccines change a person's DNA.
urdu: کووڈ 19 کی ایم آر این اے ویکسین انسان کے ڈی این اے کو تبدیل کر دیتی ہے۔
roman_urdu: COVID-19 ki mRNA vaccine insan ka DNA badal deti hai.
source_note: CDC states COVID-19 vaccines do not affect or interact with DNA and do not enter the cell nucleus.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: The A1C test reflects a person's average blood sugar over about the past two to three months.
urdu: اے ون سی ٹیسٹ تقریباً گزشتہ دو سے تین ماہ کے دوران کسی شخص کی اوسط خون میں شکر کی سطح ظاہر کرتا ہے۔
roman_urdu: A1C test taqreeban pichhle do se teen mahino ke dauran kisi shakhs ki ausat blood sugar level batata hai.
source_note: CDC describes A1C as measuring average blood sugar over 2 to 3 months.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: High salt intake is associated with increased blood pressure.
urdu: نمک کا زیادہ استعمال بلند فشارِ خون سے وابستہ ہے۔
roman_urdu: Namak ka zyada istemal high blood pressure se wabasta hai.
source_note: WHO states that high sodium intake is associated with increased blood pressure and cardiovascular disease.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Severe bleeding, mostly after childbirth, is a major cause of maternal deaths.
urdu: شدید خون بہنا، جو زیادہ تر بچے کی پیدائش کے بعد ہوتا ہے، زچگی کے دوران خواتین کی اموات کی ایک بڑی وجہ ہے۔
roman_urdu: Shadeed khoon behna, jo zyada tar bachay ki paidaish ke baad hota hai, maaon ki amwaat ki aik bari wajah hai.
source_note: WHO lists severe bleeding, mostly after childbirth, among the major complications accounting for around 75% of maternal deaths.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Inhaling steam kills the viruses that cause the common cold.
urdu: بھاپ لینے سے عام نزلہ زکام پیدا کرنے والے وائرس مر جاتے ہیں۔
roman_urdu: Bhaap lene se aam nazla zukam paida karne wale viruses mar jate hain.
source_note: The source states there is no evidence steam inhalation treats or prevents COVID-19 and no research evidence that it works as commonly claimed; avoid treating this as a claim about every virus in every context.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Honey is safe to give to babies younger than 12 months.
urdu: بارہ ماہ سے کم عمر بچوں کو شہد دینا محفوظ ہے۔
roman_urdu: Barah mah se kam umar ke bachon ko shehad dena mehfooz hai.
source_title: NHS: Foods to avoid giving babies and young children
source_note: NHS advises not giving honey to children under one year because it can contain bacteria that cause infant botulism.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Whole grains are a recommended source of carbohydrates in a healthy diet.
urdu: صحت مند غذا میں ثابت اناج کاربوہائیڈریٹس کا ایک تجویز کردہ ذریعہ ہیں۔
roman_urdu: Sehatmand ghiza mein sabit anaj carbohydrates ka aik tajweez karda zariya hain.
source_note: WHO recommends that carbohydrates should come primarily from whole grains, vegetables, fruits and pulses.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Malaria is transmitted to humans through the bites of infected mosquitoes.
urdu: ملیریا انسانوں میں متاثرہ مچھروں کے کاٹنے سے منتقل ہوتا ہے۔
roman_urdu: Malaria insano mein mutasira machharon ke kaatne se muntaqil hota hai.
source_note: WHO identifies malaria as a disease transmitted to humans by some types of mosquitoes.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Malaria spreads directly from one person to another through ordinary physical contact.
urdu: ملیریا عام جسمانی رابطے کے ذریعے براہِ راست ایک شخص سے دوسرے شخص میں منتقل ہوتا ہے۔
roman_urdu: Malaria aam jismani rabtay ke zariye barah-e-raast aik shakhs se doosray shakhs mein muntaqil hota hai.
source_note: WHO states that malaria infection does not spread from person to person; it is mosquito-borne.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Sleeping under insecticide-treated mosquito nets can help prevent malaria.
urdu: کیڑے مار دوا سے علاج شدہ مچھر دانی کے نیچے سونے سے ملیریا سے بچاؤ میں مدد مل سکتی ہے۔
roman_urdu: Keeray maar dawa se treat ki hui machhardani ke neeche sonay se malaria se bachao mein madad mil sakti hai.
source_note: WHO identifies insecticide-treated nets as a core malaria vector-control intervention.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: A person can confirm malaria by symptoms alone without a diagnostic test.
urdu: کوئی شخص تشخیصی ٹیسٹ کے بغیر صرف علامات کی بنیاد پر ملیریا کی تصدیق کر سکتا ہے۔
roman_urdu: Koi shakhs tashkheesi test ke baghair sirf alamat ki bunyaad par malaria ki tasdeeq kar sakta hai.
source_note: WHO recommends parasite-based diagnostic testing for all suspected malaria cases; symptoms are not specific.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Malaria infection during pregnancy can increase the risk of premature delivery or low birth weight.
urdu: حمل کے دوران ملیریا کا انفیکشن قبل از وقت پیدائش یا کم وزن بچے کی پیدائش کا خطرہ بڑھا سکتا ہے۔
roman_urdu: Hamal ke dauran malaria ka infection waqt se pehle paidaish ya kam wazan bachay ki paidaish ka khatra barha sakta hai.
source_note: WHO states malaria infection during pregnancy can cause premature delivery or low-birth-weight babies.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Honey can expose babies younger than 12 months to the risk of infant botulism.
urdu: شہد بارہ ماہ سے کم عمر بچوں کو شیر خوار بچوں کے بوٹولزم کے خطرے سے دوچار کر سکتا ہے۔
roman_urdu: Shehad barah mah se kam umar bachon ko infant botulism ke khatray se dochar kar sakta hai.
source_title: NHS: Foods to avoid giving babies and young children
source_note: NHS warns that honey may contain bacteria that produce toxins in an infant's intestines and says not to give honey before age one.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Whole nuts should not be given to children younger than five because they can cause choking.
urdu: پانچ سال سے کم عمر بچوں کو ثابت میوے نہیں دینے چاہییں کیونکہ ان سے دم گھٹنے کا خطرہ ہو سکتا ہے۔
roman_urdu: Paanch saal se kam umar bachon ko sabit meway nahi denay chahiye kyun ke in se dam ghutnay ka khatra ho sakta hai.
source_title: NHS: Foods to avoid giving babies and young children
source_note: NHS advises against whole nuts for children under five due to choking risk.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Adding extra salt to a baby's food is recommended for healthy kidney development.
urdu: بچے کے گردوں کی صحت مند نشوونما کے لیے اس کے کھانے میں اضافی نمک شامل کرنے کی سفارش کی جاتی ہے۔
roman_urdu: Bachay ke gurday ki sehatmand nashonuma ke liye us ke khanay mein izafi namak shamil karnay ki sifarish ki jati hai.
source_title: NHS: Foods to avoid giving babies and young children
source_note: NHS says babies should not eat much salt because it is not good for their kidneys, and advises not adding salt to baby food.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: A healthy diet can obtain carbohydrates from whole grains, vegetables, fruits, and pulses.
urdu: صحت مند غذا میں کاربوہائیڈریٹس ثابت اناج، سبزیوں، پھلوں اور دالوں سے حاصل کیے جا سکتے ہیں۔
roman_urdu: Sehatmand ghiza mein carbohydrates sabit anaj, sabziyon, phalon aur daalon se hasil kiye ja sakte hain.
source_note: WHO identifies whole grains, vegetables, fruits, and pulses as recommended primary sources of carbohydrates.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Eating one particular fruit every day guarantees that a person will never develop diabetes.
urdu: روزانہ ایک مخصوص پھل کھانے سے اس بات کی ضمانت ملتی ہے کہ کسی شخص کو کبھی ذیابیطس نہیں ہوگی۔
roman_urdu: Rozana aik khaas phal khanay se is baat ki guarantee milti hai ke kisi shakhs ko kabhi diabetes nahi hogi.
source_note: The source describes multiple diabetes risk factors and prevention approaches; it does not support a guarantee from eating one fruit. Label means the absolute, specific claim is unsupported by the cited evidence, not that fruit has no health value.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Regular physical activity can help prevent or delay the onset of type 2 diabetes.
urdu: باقاعدہ جسمانی سرگرمی ٹائپ 2 ذیابیطس کے آغاز کو روکنے یا مؤخر کرنے میں مدد دے سکتی ہے۔
roman_urdu: Baqaida jismani sargarmi type 2 diabetes ke aaghaz ko roknay ya moakhkhar karnay mein madad de sakti hai.
source_note: WHO identifies regular physical activity as one way to prevent or delay type 2 diabetes.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Everyone with high blood pressure experiences clear symptoms such as headaches.
urdu: ہائی بلڈ پریشر والے ہر شخص کو سر درد جیسی واضح علامات محسوس ہوتی ہیں۔
roman_urdu: High blood pressure walay har shakhs ko sar dard jaisi wazeh alamat mehsoos hoti hain.
source_note: WHO states that people with high blood pressure may not feel symptoms; measurement is needed to know.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: A diet high in salt is a risk factor for high blood pressure.
urdu: زیادہ نمک والی غذا ہائی بلڈ پریشر کا ایک خطرے کا عنصر ہے۔
roman_urdu: Zyada namak wali ghiza high blood pressure ka aik khatray ka ansar hai.
source_note: WHO lists a high-salt diet among factors that increase the risk of hypertension.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: A person can know for certain that they have hypertension by checking whether they feel dizzy.
urdu: کوئی شخص چکر آنے یا نہ آنے سے یقین کے ساتھ معلوم کر سکتا ہے کہ اسے ہائی بلڈ پریشر ہے یا نہیں۔
roman_urdu: Koi shakhs chakkar aanay ya na aanay se yaqeen ke saath maloom kar sakta hai ke usay high blood pressure hai ya nahi.
source_note: WHO says hypertension may have no symptoms and is detected by measuring blood pressure.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Drinking exactly two cups of green tea every morning guarantees that a person will not develop type 2 diabetes.
urdu: ہر صبح ٹھیک دو کپ سبز چائے پینے سے اس بات کی ضمانت ملتی ہے کہ کسی شخص کو ٹائپ 2 ذیابیطس نہیں ہوگی۔
roman_urdu: Har subah theek do cup green tea peenay se is baat ki guarantee milti hai ke kisi shakhs ko type 2 diabetes nahi hogi.
source_note: WHO describes several prevention measures but provides no evidence for this exact green-tea quantity or guarantee. Treat as unsupported, not proven false by this source alone.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: A daily 20-minute walk guarantees that a person will never develop any cardiovascular disease.
urdu: روزانہ 20 منٹ پیدل چلنے سے اس بات کی ضمانت ملتی ہے کہ کسی شخص کو کبھی کوئی قلبی بیماری نہیں ہوگی۔
roman_urdu: Rozana 20 minute paidal chalnay se is baat ki guarantee milti hai ke kisi shakhs ko kabhi koi qalbi bemari nahi hogi.
source_note: WHO supports physical activity as risk reduction, not a guarantee against all cardiovascular disease; the exact 20-minute claim is not established.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Quitting tobacco can reduce the risk of cardiovascular disease.
urdu: تمباکو نوشی چھوڑنے سے قلبی بیماری کا خطرہ کم ہو سکتا ہے۔
roman_urdu: Tambaku noshi chhornay se qalbi bemari ka khatra kam ho sakta hai.
source_note: WHO lists tobacco cessation among measures shown to reduce cardiovascular disease risk.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Antibiotics treat infections caused by viruses such as influenza.
urdu: اینٹی بایوٹکس انفلوئنزا جیسے وائرس سے ہونے والے انفیکشن کا علاج کرتی ہیں۔
roman_urdu: Antibiotics influenza jaisay virus se honay walay infection ka ilaaj karti hain.
source_title: CDC: Healthy Habits—Antibiotic Do's and Don'ts
source_note: CDC states antibiotics do not work on viruses, including viruses that cause colds and flu.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Eating a bowl of spinach every night reverses every form of diabetes within one month.
urdu: ہر رات ایک پیالہ پالک کھانے سے ایک ماہ کے اندر ذیابیطس کی ہر قسم ختم ہو جاتی ہے۔
roman_urdu: Har raat aik piyala palak khanay se aik mah ke andar diabetes ki har qisam khatam ho jati hai.
source_note: WHO describes diabetes as a chronic disease and discusses management; it does not support this specific food-based cure or one-month timeline. Label as unsupported claim.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: A specific homemade juice formula lowers blood pressure by exactly 30 mmHg in every adult within three days.
urdu: گھر میں تیار کردہ ایک مخصوص جوس کا نسخہ ہر بالغ شخص کا بلڈ پریشر تین دن میں ٹھیک 30 ملی میٹر مرکری کم کر دیتا ہے۔
roman_urdu: Ghar mein tayyar kardah aik khaas juice ka nuskha har baligh shakhs ka blood pressure teen din mein theek 30 millimeter mercury kam kar deta hai.
source_note: WHO describes established lifestyle changes and medication but does not substantiate this exact juice, effect size, universal result, or timeline.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Dengue is transmitted to people mainly through the bites of infected Aedes mosquitoes.
urdu: ڈینگی بنیادی طور پر متاثرہ ایڈیز مچھروں کے کاٹنے سے لوگوں میں منتقل ہوتا ہے۔
roman_urdu: Dengue bunyadi tor par mutasira Aedes machharon ke kaatne se logon mein muntqil hota hai.
source_note: WHO identifies infected Aedes mosquitoes as the main vector for dengue transmission.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Tuberculosis spreads directly by sharing eating utensils with an infected person.
urdu: تپِ دق کسی متاثرہ شخص کے ساتھ کھانے کے برتن بانٹنے سے براہِ راست پھیلتا ہے۔
roman_urdu: Tuberculosis kisi mutasira shakhs ke sath khanay ke bartan baantnay se barah-e-raast phailta hai.
source_note: CDC explains that TB spreads through the air when a person with active TB coughs, speaks, or sings, not by sharing utensils.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: A garlic drink guarantees that a person will not catch any respiratory infection.
urdu: لہسن کا مشروب اس بات کی ضمانت دیتا ہے کہ کسی شخص کو سانس کا کوئی انفیکشن نہیں ہوگا۔
roman_urdu: Lehsan ka mashroob is baat ki guarantee deta hai ke kisi shakhs ko saans ka koi infection nahi hoga.
source_note: The cited guidance discusses healthy diets but does not establish a guarantee that a garlic drink prevents every respiratory infection.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Wearing a mask prevents every respiratory infection for every person.
urdu: ماسک پہننے سے ہر شخص کو سانس کے ہر انفیکشن سے تحفظ مل جاتا ہے۔
roman_urdu: Mask pehnay se har shakhs ko saans ke har infection se tahaffuz mil jata hai.
source_note: CDC describes masks as one prevention strategy, but the cited guidance does not establish a universal guarantee against every respiratory infection.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Antibiotics cure influenza because influenza is a bacterial infection.
urdu: اینٹی بایوٹکس انفلوئنزا کا علاج کرتی ہیں کیونکہ انفلوئنزا بیکٹیریا کا انفیکشن ہے۔
roman_urdu: Antibiotics influenza ka ilaaj karti hain kyun ke influenza bacteria ka infection hai.
source_title: CDC: Antibiotic Use and Your Health
source_note: Influenza is caused by viruses, and CDC states that antibiotics do not work on viruses.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Routine childhood vaccination completely eliminates the risk of every vaccine-preventable disease.
urdu: بچوں کی معمول کی ویکسینیشن ویکسین سے روکی جانے والی ہر بیماری کا خطرہ مکمل طور پر ختم کر دیتی ہے۔
roman_urdu: Bachon ki mamool ki vaccination vaccine se roki janay wali har bemari ka khatra mukammal tor par khatam kar deti hai.
source_note: WHO supports vaccination as highly effective prevention but does not establish elimination of every risk for every vaccinated person.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Vaccines cause autism in children.
urdu: ویکسین بچوں میں آٹزم پیدا کرتی ہیں۔
roman_urdu: Vaccines bachon mein autism paida karti hain.
source_note: CDC states that studies have not found a link between vaccines and autism.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: A seasonal influenza vaccine prevents every influenza infection.
urdu: موسمی فلو کی ویکسین انفلوئنزا کے ہر انفیکشن سے بچاؤ کرتی ہے۔
roman_urdu: Mausami flu ki vaccine influenza ke har infection se bachao karti hai.
source_title: CDC: Key Facts About Seasonal Flu Vaccine
source_note: CDC describes variable effectiveness and risk reduction, not prevention of every influenza infection.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: One dose of any vaccine guarantees lifelong protection against every infection.
urdu: کسی بھی ویکسین کی ایک خوراک ہر انفیکشن سے زندگی بھر تحفظ کی ضمانت دیتی ہے۔
roman_urdu: Kisi bhi vaccine ki aik khuraak har infection se zindagi bhar tahaffuz ki guarantee deti hai.
source_note: General immunization guidance does not establish this universal lifelong guarantee; schedules and protection vary by disease and vaccine.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: One polio vaccine dose completely eliminates a child's risk of poliovirus disease.
urdu: پولیو کی ویکسین کی ایک خوراک بچے میں پولیو وائرس کی بیماری کا خطرہ مکمل طور پر ختم کر دیتی ہے۔
roman_urdu: Polio ki vaccine ki aik khuraak bachay mein polio virus ki bemari ka khatra mukammal tor par khatam kar deti hai.
source_note: WHO supports polio vaccination but does not establish this single-dose, zero-risk guarantee.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: For every disease, natural infection is safer than vaccination.
urdu: ہر بیماری کے لیے قدرتی انفیکشن ویکسین لگوانے سے زیادہ محفوظ ہوتا ہے۔
roman_urdu: Har bemari ke liye qudrati infection vaccine lagwanay se zyada mehfooz hota hai.
source_note: Vaccination is intended to provide protection without the risks of the disease itself; the universal comparative claim is contradicted by immunization guidance.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: A vaccine dose guarantees that a person can never become infected with the targeted pathogen.
urdu: ویکسین کی ایک خوراک اس بات کی ضمانت دیتی ہے کہ کسی شخص کو ہدف بنائے گئے جرثومے سے کبھی انفیکشن نہیں ہوگا۔
roman_urdu: Vaccine ki aik khuraak is baat ki guarantee deti hai ke kisi shakhs ko hadaf banaye gaye jarsoome se kabhi infection nahi hoga.
source_note: Vaccines can reduce risk and severity, but the cited general guidance does not establish a universal guarantee against infection.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: COVID-19 vaccination prevents all severe illness and death from COVID-19.
urdu: کووڈ 19 کی ویکسین کووڈ 19 کی ہر شدید بیماری اور موت کو روک دیتی ہے۔
roman_urdu: COVID-19 ki vaccine COVID-19 ki har shadeed bemari aur maut ko rok deti hai.
source_title: CDC: Benefits of Getting a COVID-19 Vaccine

english: Eating a variety of fruits and vegetables is part of a healthy diet.
urdu: مختلف قسم کے پھل اور سبزیاں کھانا صحت مند غذا کا حصہ ہے۔
roman_urdu: Mukhtalif qisam ke phal aur sabziyan khana sehatmand ghiza ka hissa hai.
source_note: WHO recommends a varied diet that includes fruits and vegetables.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: A detox juice removes all harmful toxins from every person's body.
urdu: ڈیٹاکس جوس ہر شخص کے جسم سے تمام نقصان دہ زہریلے مادے نکال دیتا ہے۔
roman_urdu: Detox juice har shakhs ke jism se tamam nuqsan-deh zehreelay maday nikal deta hai.
source_note: NHS states that detox diets are not supported by good evidence and that the body has its own systems for removing waste.

english: Eating one particular food every day prevents all types of cancer.
urdu: روزانہ ایک مخصوص غذا کھانے سے کینسر کی ہر قسم سے بچاؤ ہو جاتا ہے۔
roman_urdu: Rozana aik makhsoos ghiza khanay se cancer ki har qisam se bachao ho jata hai.
source_note: Cancer has multiple causes and the cited guidance does not establish that one food prevents every cancer type.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Raw milk is safer than pasteurized milk for everyone.
urdu: کچا دودھ ہر شخص کے لیے پاسچرائزڈ دودھ سے زیادہ محفوظ ہے۔
roman_urdu: Kacha doodh har shakhs ke liye pasteurized doodh se zyada mehfooz hai.
source_note: CDC warns that raw milk can contain harmful germs and that pasteurization reduces those risks.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Eating high-fiber foods prevents every digestive disease.
urdu: زیادہ فائبر والی غذائیں نظامِ ہاضمہ کی ہر بیماری سے بچاؤ کرتی ہیں۔
roman_urdu: Zyada fiber wali ghizayen nizam-e-hazma ki har bemari se bachao karti hain.
source_note: Dietary guidance supports fiber-containing foods but does not establish prevention of every digestive disease.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Taking folic acid before and during early pregnancy helps reduce the risk of neural tube defects.
urdu: حمل سے پہلے اور حمل کے ابتدائی مرحلے میں فولک ایسڈ لینے سے نیورل ٹیوب کی پیدائشی خامیوں کا خطرہ کم کرنے میں مدد ملتی ہے۔
roman_urdu: Hamal se pehle aur hamal ke ibtidai marhalay mein folic acid lenay se neural tube ki paidaishi khamiyon ka khatra kam karne mein madad milti hai.
source_note: CDC recommends folic acid and describes its role in reducing neural tube defects.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Honey is safe for every infant younger than 12 months.
urdu: بارہ ماہ سے کم عمر ہر شیر خوار بچے کے لیے شہد محفوظ ہے۔
roman_urdu: Barah mah se kam umar har sheerkhar bachay ke liye shehad mehfooz hai.
source_title: NHS: Foods to avoid giving babies and young children
source_note: NHS advises against honey before age one because of infant botulism risk.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Breastfeeding prevents every infection in every infant.
urdu: ماں کا دودھ ہر شیر خوار بچے کو ہر انفیکشن سے محفوظ رکھتا ہے۔
roman_urdu: Maa ka doodh har sheerkhar bachay ko har infection se mehfooz rakhta hai.
source_note: WHO describes important nutritional and immune benefits, but not a universal prevention guarantee.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: A routine pregnancy ultrasound guarantees that a baby will be born completely healthy.
urdu: حمل کے دوران معمول کا الٹراساؤنڈ اس بات کی ضمانت دیتا ہے کہ بچہ مکمل طور پر صحت مند پیدا ہوگا۔
roman_urdu: Hamal ke dauran mamool ka ultrasound is baat ki guarantee deta hai ke bacha mukammal tor par sehatmand paida hoga.
source_note: NHS explains what scans can and cannot detect; a scan cannot establish a guarantee of complete health.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Regular physical activity can help people manage blood glucose in type 2 diabetes.
urdu: باقاعدہ جسمانی سرگرمی ٹائپ 2 ذیابیطس میں خون میں شکر کو قابو میں رکھنے میں مدد دے سکتی ہے۔
roman_urdu: Baqaida jismani sargarmi type 2 diabetes mein khoon mein shakar ko qaboo mein rakhnay mein madad de sakti hai.
source_note: CDC explains that physical activity helps manage blood sugar and overall diabetes health.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Antibiotics work against viruses that cause colds and flu.
urdu: اینٹی بایوٹکس نزلہ زکام اور فلو پیدا کرنے والے وائرسوں کے خلاف کام کرتی ہیں۔
roman_urdu: Antibiotics nazla zukam aur flu paida karne walay viruson ke khilaf kaam karti hain.
source_title: CDC: Antibiotic Use and Your Health
source_note: CDC states antibiotics do not work on viruses, including those causing colds and flu.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: People should take antibiotics only when prescribed and exactly as directed.
urdu: لوگوں کو اینٹی بایوٹکس صرف نسخے کے مطابق اور ہدایت کے عین مطابق لینی چاہییں۔
roman_urdu: Logon ko antibiotics sirf nuskhe ke mutabiq aur hidayat ke ain mutabiq leni chahiye.
source_title: CDC: Antibiotic Use and Your Health
source_note: CDC advises taking antibiotics exactly as prescribed and not sharing or saving them.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Stopping a prescribed medicine early is always safe if symptoms improve.
urdu: اگر علامات بہتر ہو جائیں تو تجویز کردہ دوا جلد بند کرنا ہمیشہ محفوظ ہوتا ہے۔
roman_urdu: Agar alamat behtar ho jayein to tajweez karda dawa jald band karna hamesha mehfooz hota hai.
source_note: General medication safety guidance does not support an unconditional rule to stop prescribed medicine early.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: A herbal supplement is guaranteed to lower every adult's blood pressure within 24 hours.
urdu: ایک جڑی بوٹی کا سپلیمنٹ 24 گھنٹوں کے اندر ہر بالغ کا بلڈ پریشر کم کرنے کی ضمانت دیتا ہے۔
roman_urdu: Aik jari booti ka supplement 24 ghanton ke andar har baligh ka blood pressure kam karne ki guarantee deta hai.
source_note: NHS warns that evidence and safety vary for herbal medicines; the exact universal 24-hour guarantee is not established.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Ibuprofen can relieve pain and fever when used according to the label and a person's medical advice.
urdu: لیبل اور طبی مشورے کے مطابق استعمال کرنے سے آئبوپروفین درد اور بخار میں آرام دے سکتی ہے۔
roman_urdu: Label aur tibbi mashwaray ke mutabiq istemal karne se ibuprofen dard aur bukhar mein aaram de sakti hai.
source_note: NHS lists pain and fever relief among uses of ibuprofen, subject to contraindications and directions.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Taking more acetaminophen than directed makes an infection go away faster.
urdu: ہدایت سے زیادہ ایسیٹامینوفن لینے سے انفیکشن جلدی ختم ہو جاتا ہے۔
roman_urdu: Hidayat se zyada acetaminophen lenay se infection jaldi khatam ho jata hai.
source_note: FDA warns that exceeding the recommended dose can cause severe liver damage; acetaminophen does not cure infections.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: One over-the-counter medicine cures every type of headache in every adult.
urdu: ایک بغیر نسخے کی دوا ہر بالغ شخص کے ہر قسم کے سر درد کا علاج کر دیتی ہے۔
roman_urdu: Aik baghair nuskhe ki dawa har baligh shakhs ke har qisam ke sar dard ka ilaaj kar deti hai.
source_note: Headaches have different causes and the cited guidance does not establish a universal cure from one medicine.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Oral rehydration solution cures every cause of diarrhoea in all adults.
urdu: منہ کے ذریعے دیا جانے والا ری ہائیڈریشن محلول تمام بالغوں میں اسہال کی ہر وجہ کا علاج کر دیتا ہے۔
roman_urdu: Munh ke zariye diya janay wala rehydration mahlool tamam balighon mein ishal ki har wajah ka ilaaj kar deta hai.
source_note: WHO supports oral rehydration for dehydration, not a universal cure for every cause of diarrhoea.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Steam inhalation cures COVID-19.
urdu: بھاپ لینا کووڈ 19 کا علاج ہے۔
roman_urdu: Bhaap lena COVID-19 ka ilaaj hai.
source_note: WHO myth-busting guidance does not support steam inhalation as a cure for COVID-19.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Drinking lemon water prevents every respiratory infection.
urdu: لیموں پانی پینے سے سانس کے ہر انفیکشن سے بچاؤ ہو جاتا ہے۔
roman_urdu: Lemon pani peenay se saans ke har infection se bachao ho jata hai.
source_note: Healthy-diet guidance does not establish a universal prevention effect for lemon water.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Honey may help soothe a cough in adults and children older than one year.
urdu: شہد بالغوں اور ایک سال سے زیادہ عمر کے بچوں میں کھانسی کو سکون دینے میں مدد کر سکتا ہے۔
roman_urdu: Shehad balighon aur aik saal se zyada umar ke bachon mein khansi ko sukoon denay mein madad kar sakta hai.
source_note: NHS notes that hot lemon with honey may have a similar effect to cough medicines for people over one year.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Applying toothpaste to a burn is recommended first aid.
urdu: جلنے پر ٹوتھ پیسٹ لگانا ابتدائی طبی امداد کے طور پر تجویز کیا جاتا ہے۔
roman_urdu: Jalnay par toothpaste lagana ibtidai tibbi imdad ke tor par tajweez kiya jata hai.
source_note: NHS first-aid guidance recommends cool running water and says not to apply creams, oils, or butter; toothpaste is not recommended.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Onion syrup cures pneumonia in every child.
urdu: پیاز کا شربت ہر بچے کے نمونیا کا علاج کر دیتا ہے۔
roman_urdu: Piyaz ka sharbat har bachay ke pneumonia ka ilaaj kar deta hai.
source_note: WHO describes pneumonia as requiring appropriate medical assessment and treatment; it does not establish this universal home-cure claim.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Drinking adequate fluids can help relieve some cold symptoms.
urdu: مناسب مقدار میں سیال پینا نزلہ زکام کی بعض علامات میں آرام دے سکتا ہے۔
roman_urdu: Munasib miqdaar mein sayyal peena nazla zukam ki baaz alamat mein aaram de sakta hai.
source_note: NHS self-care guidance recommends drinking plenty of fluids while recovering from a cold.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Essential oils used in a room kill every virus in the air.
urdu: کمرے میں استعمال کیے گئے ضروری تیل ہوا میں موجود ہر وائرس کو مار دیتے ہیں۔
roman_urdu: Kamray mein istemal kiye gaye zaroori tail hawa mein mojood har virus ko maar detay hain.
source_note: Public-health hygiene guidance does not support essential oils as a universal airborne-virus disinfectant.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Apple-cider vinegar lowers every adult's blood pressure by exactly 20 mmHg.
urdu: سیب کے سرکے سے ہر بالغ کا بلڈ پریشر ٹھیک 20 ملی میٹر مرکری کم ہو جاتا ہے۔
roman_urdu: Sib ke sirke se har baligh ka blood pressure theek 20 millimeter mercury kam ho jata hai.
source_note: WHO hypertension guidance does not establish this exact, universal effect size or timeline.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review

english: Gargling with warm salt water may soothe a sore throat for some people.
urdu: نیم گرم نمک والے پانی سے غرارے کرنے سے کچھ لوگوں کے گلے کے درد میں آرام آ سکتا ہے۔
roman_urdu: Neem garam namak walay pani se ghararay karnay se kuch logon ke galay ke dard mein aaram aa sakta hai.
source_note: NHS lists gargling with warm salty water as a self-care measure for sore throat in adults.
review_status: Pending qualified Urdu/Roman Urdu review and independent source-label review
